latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Music Cog Free (version 1.0.0).
- Upload MP4, MOV, AVI, or WebM videos up to 500MB to automatically remove copyrighted music and replace it with royalty-free tracks.
- No need for professional video editing software or manual re-editing—processes run on cloud GPUs, delivering copyright-free videos in 30–60 seconds.
- Supports export in multiple formats (MP4 by default, up to 1080p).
- Designed for content creators seeking to avoid copyright claims easily and efficiently.
